# Example.Weather

<!-- Generated by crucible. Change the model or the SDK configuration and regenerate. -->

The C# client for the Weather API (`example.weather#Weather`, API version `2026-10-01`, sent as `Crucible-Version: 2026-10-01` on every request), generated by [Crucible](https://github.com/Operation-Leyline/crucible) from the service's model.

## Install

```sh
dotnet add package Example.Weather --version 0.0.0-dev
```

or declare it in the project's manifest:

```xml
<PackageReference Include="Example.Weather" Version="0.0.0-dev" />
```

The package is `Example.Weather`, version `0.0.0-dev`; code refers to it as `Example.Weather`.

## Create a client

```csharp
using Example.Weather;
using Example.Weather.Models;

using var client = new WeatherClient(new ClientConfig
{
    Token = _ => ValueTask.FromResult(Environment.GetEnvironmentVariable("WEATHER_TOKEN")),
});
```

`ClientConfig.Token` returns the bearer token (a `ValueTask<string?>`), called for every attempt with the call's cancellation token, so a refreshed token is used. The client is `IDisposable`; share one instance. The client sends `Authorization: Bearer <token>` and `Crucible-Version: 2026-10-01` on every request.

## Call an operation

`GetCity` calls `GetCity`. Every operation has a method like it.

```csharp
using System;
using System.Globalization;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Example.Weather;
using Example.Weather.Models;

// The client sends Authorization: Bearer <token> and Crucible-Version: 2026-10-01 on every request.
using var client = new WeatherClient(new ClientConfig
{
    Token = _ => ValueTask.FromResult(Environment.GetEnvironmentVariable("WEATHER_TOKEN")),
});

// Values from the model's example "Read a city".
var input = new GetCityInput
{
    CityId = "c-0a1b2c3d",
    At = DateTimeOffset.Parse("2026-01-02T03:04:05Z", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),
};

try
{
    var output = await client.GetCityAsync(input);
    Console.WriteLine(output.City);
    Console.WriteLine(output.Forecast);
    Console.WriteLine(output.RequestIdValue);
}
catch (NotFoundError error)
{
    Console.Error.WriteLine($"NotFoundError (HTTP {error.StatusCode}): {error.MessageValue}");
}
```

## Pagination

A paginated operation also has a `<Operation>PagesAsync` method returning an `IAsyncEnumerable` of pages (`await foreach (var page in client.ListThingsPagesAsync(input))`): each page is one response, and it stops when the response carries no next token. Every operation has an awaitable `<Operation>Async` method and a blocking `<Operation>` beside it, each taking an optional `CancellationToken`.

```csharp
using System;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Example.Weather;
using Example.Weather.Models;

// The client sends Authorization: Bearer <token> and Crucible-Version: 2026-10-01 on every request.
using var client = new WeatherClient(new ClientConfig
{
    Token = _ => ValueTask.FromResult(Environment.GetEnvironmentVariable("WEATHER_TOKEN")),
});

// Values from the model's example "List the first page".
var input = new ListCitiesInput
{
    MaxResults = 2,
    Tags = ["coastal", "capital"],
};

// Each page is one response; the walker sends `nextToken` for the next.
await foreach (var page in client.ListCitiesPagesAsync(input))
{
    Console.WriteLine(page.Cities);
}
```

## Errors

Each modelled error is an exception class in `Example.Weather.Models`, deriving from `Example.Weather.WeatherException` and `ServiceError`: catch it and read its properties, and `StatusCode`, `RequestId` and `Headers`. A modelled member named like an `Exception` property takes a `Value` suffix (`MessageValue`). Transport failures throw `NetworkError`.

## Retries and idempotency

Calls are retried with backoff when a retry is safe: a modelled throttling error is retried for any operation; transport failures, HTTP 500, 502, 503 and 504 and other retryable modelled errors only for operations that are read-only, idempotent or carry an idempotency token. An idempotency token the caller leaves unset is generated once per call and reused on every attempt; set it yourself to replay one logical request across calls. These operations fill a token: `CreateCity` (`ClientToken`). Set `MaxAttempts` in `ClientConfig` to change the attempt limit (3, the first included; 1 turns retries off), `Timeout`, `BaseDelay` and `MaxDelay` for the call budget and backoff, and `RetryMode` to `RetryMode.Standard` or `RetryMode.Adaptive` for a shared retry quota or client-side rate limiting.
